import { chromium } from 'playwright'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { root, artifact, browserOptions } from './environment.mjs'

const browser = await chromium.launch(browserOptions)
const checks = []
try {
  const context = await browser.newContext({colorScheme:'dark',viewport:{width:390,height:844}})
  await context.route('**/api/cent/v1/**',route => route.fulfill({status:200,contentType:'application/json',body:JSON.stringify(route.request().url().endsWith('/google/config')?{enabled:false,mode:'AuthorizationCode',clientId:null}:{})}))
  // Record the document attribute at DOMContentLoaded, before interacting with React.
  await context.addInitScript(() => {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',() => { window.__themeAtDomReady = document.documentElement.dataset.theme },{once:true})
  })
  const page=await context.newPage()
  await page.goto(root+'/login')
  const control=page.getByLabel('ظاهر',{exact:true})
  await control.waitFor()
  assert.equal(await control.inputValue(),'system')
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme),'dark')
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>window.__themeAtDomReady),'dark')
  checks.push('System default and dark attribute resolved by DOMContentLoaded')
  await control.selectOption('light')
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme),'light')
  await page.reload();await control.waitFor()
  assert.equal(await control.inputValue(),'light')
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>window.__themeAtDomReady),'light')
  await page.emulateMedia({colorScheme:'dark'})
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme),'light')
  checks.push('Explicit light persists/reloads and ignores system dark')
  await control.selectOption('dark');await page.reload();await control.waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme),'dark')
  await page.getByRole('link',{name:'ایتاتست — صفحه اصلی'}).first().click()
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme),'dark')
  checks.push('Explicit dark persists across reload and public navigation')
  await page.getByLabel('ظاهر',{exact:true}).selectOption('system')
  await page.emulateMedia({colorScheme:'light'})
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme==='light')
  await page.emulateMedia({colorScheme:'dark'})
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme==='dark')
  checks.push('System selection follows live OS changes in both directions')
  const select=page.getByLabel('ظاهر',{exact:true})
  await select.focus()
  assert.equal(await select.evaluate(el=>el===document.activeElement),true)
  const focus=await select.evaluate(el=>({outline:getComputedStyle(el).outlineStyle,height:el.getBoundingClientRect().height}))
  assert.notEqual(focus.outline,'none');assert.ok(focus.height>=44)
  await page.keyboard.press('Home');await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  assert.equal(await select.inputValue(),'light')
  checks.push('Native selector has associated visible label, keyboard operation, focus ring and >=44px height')
  for(const theme of ['light','dark']) {
    await select.selectOption(theme)
    for(const width of [320,375,390,768,1024,1280,1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({width,height:900})
      assert.ok(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1),`${theme} home overflow ${width}`)
    }
  }
  checks.push('Home has no document horizontal overflow at seven widths in both themes')
  assert.match(await page.title(),/Itatest/)
  assert.equal(await page.locator('link[rel=icon]').getAttribute('href'),new URL(root).pathname+'/brand/favicon.svg')
  checks.push('Platform browser title and base-path favicon updated')
  await context.close()
  const blocked=await browser.newContext({colorScheme:'dark'})
  await blocked.addInitScript(()=>Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{get(){throw Error('blocked test storage')}}))
  const blockedPage=await blocked.newPage();await blockedPage.goto(root+'/login')
  await blockedPage.getByLabel('ظاهر',{exact:true}).selectOption('light')
  assert.equal(await blockedPage.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.theme),'light')
  checks.push('Storage-denied startup and in-memory switching remain usable')
  await blocked.close()
  writeFileSync(artifact('appearance-result.json'),JSON.stringify({success:true,kind:'Appearance checks; local API responses mocked only in first context',checks},null,2))
  console.log(`Appearance browser checks passed: ${checks.length}`)
} finally { await browser.close() }
